component.name: ReShadeLinux
component.summary: Install ReShade for Wine and Proton games on Linux

description.p: Download ReShade and shader repositories, then link them into any Windows game running under Wine or Proton on Linux. Provides automatic Steam game detection, per-game shader selection, and a graphical or terminal UI.

ul.li: Automatic Steam library scanning and game detection
PE import table analysis to pick the correct DLL override
Per-game shader selection from a curated repository catalog
Batch update for all installed games at once

description.p: The shader picker gets Select all and Select none buttons, problems are shown with a warning icon, and output is coloured only on a terminal (NO_COLOR is honoured). The graphical launcher no longer opens a terminal window for scripted runs.

Fix the graphical interface: message, question and error dialogs did not appear on current yad, the action list could start an install instead of an uninstall, names containing angle brackets were garbled, and uninstall and update-all finished without any confirmation. Starting from the menu without yad now opens a terminal, and a symlinked ReShade.ini is kept as a link. Adds real-yad smoke tests, an opt-in shader compile check and smoke checklists.

Fix shader packs that did not compile or load under Proton: effects in subfolders now appear, a pack selected on its own gets the core headers, packs can require other packs, and effects that never compile are left out. Add 25 shader packs, fix CShade and packs that keep effects at the repository root.

Fix game detection dropping executables such as reach.exe, show an error dialog when a required program is missing, harden downloads (exact URL check, literal hash pin, pinned appimagetool), keep the ReShade latest link across failed updates, and add two official shader packs.
Route AppImage startup through the GUI wrapper, harden backend and dependency validation, and verify ReShade downloads more strictly before install.
Add "Update all installed games" option in the install/uninstall dialog. Fix shader compilation failures when a repo containing shared .fxh headers was not selected.
Diagnostics and test helpers now include explicit ShellCheck hints for clean repository-wide analysis.
Single-source versioning, rich shader repository descriptions, expanded to 18 curated repos, and improved game detection.
